column1: # Visium HD mouse brain: curated region / layer annotation, applied by `annotate_regions.py apply`.
# level dom_r1 = region-level Leiden clusters (own + neighbourhood PCs, resolution 1) of each section on its own;
# level sub_CTXhi = the isocortex-like domains re-clustered (subcluster_spec.tsv, resolution 1.0) and annotated into layers.
# Evidence = cluster means of the marker panel (x100 log1p CP10k), top Wilcoxon DE genes, position on the section map;
# CellTypist (Allen WMB) subclass shares are quoted only as a reference. "nan" = not scored (mixed / scattered / tiny).
# Region names follow Allen CCFv3; TH split by Prkcd (high in the sensory-motor / lateral nuclei, low in the
# midline, intralaminar and anterior nuclei), which is the split visible in every section.
